ledger: Diner Building | Exterior: Right of truck, illuminated windows | Interior: Counter, booths, kitchen pass-through | Fixed architecture connecting exterior and interior
Semi-Truck | Exterior: Left of building, White cab/Dark trailer | Exterior: Right of building exit path, Dark cab/White trailer | Position and color scheme changed
Interior Counter | Runs parallel to windows, separates seating and service | Same | Waitress and Man interact across it
Booths | Left wall along windows | Same | Static seating
Front Door | Entry/Exit near windows | Same | Used by Man for entry and exit

findings.description: At 00:00 the semi-truck is parked to the left of the diner building. At 01:41 the man exits the diner and walks towards a truck positioned to the right of the exit path, and the truck's cab/trailer colors have inverted (white cab/dark trailer vs dark cab/white trailer).
